elaine: Hey folks — noticed something odd on my tax docs. I converted from contractor -> FTE on 2025-11-15 but I just received a 1099 for Nov payroll and also a regular net pay on 11/30. Did the vendor final invoice and payroll both go out?

 tom_payroll: @elaine ugh, thanks for flagging. Can you DM me the invoice number? We usually block vendor final invoices after conversion but looks like a gap.

 elaine: Invoice 98765, vendor name 'Elaine Contracting LLC'. Sent you a DM with the PDF.

 payroll-bot: Payroll run 2025-11-30 (run_id: pr-20251130-17) posted: 1 payment to eml-12345; Vendor AP run 2025-11-30 (ap_id: ap-20251130-88) posted: invoice 98765.

 tom_payroll: Confirmed both runs posted. Looks like AP didn't have the conversion flag in their system. We'll need to reverse one payment. Which should be reversed, AP or payroll? @mike_finance will advise.

 mike_finance: We prefer reversing the vendor/payment from AP and issue a correcting 1099 if already filed. If payroll already withheld taxes for the salary portion we keep the payroll payment. We need to know if any withholding was applied to the vendor payment (usually none).

 anna_peopleops: Quick note — when conversion happened we sent the conversion form on 11/14 but maybe AP's vendor record wasn't deactivated. @tom_payroll please coordinate with AP. Also cc: tax for 1099 vs W-2 treatment.

 tom_payroll: OK I'll open an AP reversal ticket. Action plan: 1) Put a hold on vendor account (AP). 2) Reverse AP payment 98765 and confirm refund to company. 3) If 1099 already generated for year-end, create a 1099-reversal + coordinate W-2 reporting for full-year wages.

 elaine: Do I need to do anything on my side? I want to avoid extra tax liability or duplicate income showing.

 mike_finance: We'll handle it. Please keep copies of the vendor invoice and any correspondence. If you've already filed estimated taxes based on the 1099, we'll advise tax team for next steps.

 tom_payroll: ETA: I'll request AP reversal today and follow up here once vendor refund confirmed. If we can't reverse before 12/31 we'll need to issue a corrected 1099 (1099-Cancel) and ensure W-2 totals reflect only payroll wages.

 anna_peopleops: Thanks for flagging @elaine — apologies for the mixup. We'll update the vendor offboarding checklist so conversions block AP runs automatically. :mechanic:

 tom_payroll: Update 20m: AP acknowledged, reversal requested for ap-20251130-88. I'll post confirmation once funds post back.
